A term of  an algebraic expression is a product of factors.  Here each factor or product 
of factors is called the co-efficient of the remaining product of factors.

it will be understood that we are referring to the numerical co-efficient.  If no numerical 
co-efficient appears in a term, then the co-efficient is understood to be 1.
